title: Mai ɗauke da Alamomi Guda Tara
intro: Wani mutum ya tashi daga mafi ƙasƙanci na farko, tare da ƙaddara da aka rubuta cikin nufin Allah. An ɓoye shi tun yana ƙarami kuma an ɗaga shi a cikin ganuwar mai mulkin da ya nemi halaka mutanensa, daga ƙarshe aka kira wannan ruhin zuwa ga wani babban aiki. Suna da komai sai bangaskiya da sandar makiyayi mai tawali'u, suka tsaya a gaban mai mulki mafi ƙarfi na wannan zamani suka nemi 'yanci ga waɗanda aka bautar. Duniya da kanta ta yi kama da tana motsi bisa ga umarninsu - ruwa ya rabu, sammai suka yi magana, mulki kuma ya faɗi.
clues: Kwanakin farko na sun kasance cikin tsoro - jarirai irina ana farautar su a lokacin haihuwa ta hannun wani mai mulki marar tausayi wanda ke tsoron makomar.
Ruwa ya cece ni, aka kuma rene ni a cikin fadar sarkin da ke neman halaka ni.
Na gudu daga ƙasarmu bayan wani lamari na bazata, na zama makiyayi mai tawali'u a wata ƙasa mai nisa.
Na koma na fuskanci wannan mai iko da sanda mai sauƙi da kuma saƙo mai haske, ina neman 'yancin jama'ata.
Na raba ruwa mai yawa ga waɗanda suka biyo ni, kuma na kalli yadda waɗannan ruwan suka haɗiye maƙiyina gaba ɗaya.
Na hau wani dutse mai tsarki don samun shiriya daga Allah, kuma an ba ni alamomi guda tara bayyanannu a matsayin hujja ta gaskiya.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
